fluency.band6: A chain of reasons, but repetitive (“polite… polite… like you… friends”).
fluency.band9: Strong claim → two benefits → condition (“That said, it has to be genuine”) → example of fake politeness.

lexical.band9: costs nothing, goes a long way, willing to help, make a good first impression, genuine, behind their back.
